introduction: South Carolina Legal Services screens requests for free civil legal help. Apply online or use its statewide telephone intake line.
description: South Carolina Legal Services screens requests for free civil legal help. Apply online or use its statewide telephone intake line.

sections.who: Eligibility depends on income, assets and the legal issue. Special grants can affect the financial screening. The provider does not handle criminal cases.
sections.get: SCLS assesses whether legal assistance is available for the qualifying civil matter.
sections.docs:

  • Court papers, notices and approaching dates.
sections.apply:
1. Start intake

    Use SCLS intake instructions or call 888-346-5592 Monday–Thursday, 9 a.m.–6 p.m.

  2. Explain your issue

    Tell staff about deadlines and provide requested evidence.

  3. Clarify the next step

    Ask whether your case has been accepted and how the local office will contact you.
sections.after: Keep copies and follow court instructions while intake is pending.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using SCLS eligibility and intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: No. It describes civil, non-criminal assistance.
The provider says it does not give legal advice over that intake line.
What if I need a language other than English or Spanish?
The provider directs you to contact a local SCLS office.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
